premises.statement: Invoice items with null service_start_day should not produce an account-month row in monthly recurring revenue.
premises.evidence_of_dependence: The month_spine and classified_items CTEs both use `WHERE service_start_day IS NOT NULL`.
premises.alternative: The contract says to build the spine as "distinct pairs of (account_id, month of service_start_day set to the first day)" and that output "includes every (account_id, account_month) from the month spine," without excluding null dates.
premises.reason: The additional filter removes account/null-month rows that the specified spine could retain.

premises.statement: The enhanced line-item payment_method_id may come from the payment rather than the invoice-payment mapping.
premises.alternative: The output contract specifies "Payment method id from invoice_payments.payment_method_id; NULL if no related invoice_payment" for payment_method_id.
premises.reason: Different or missing payment records can change the identifier emitted under the required column name.

premises.statement: The enhanced line-item output is permitted to contain an additional invoice_payment_method_id column beyond the documented output columns.
premises.evidence_of_dependence: `ip.payment_method_id AS invoice_payment_method_id` followed by `SELECT *, row_number() ... FROM joined`
premises.alternative: The documented columns include payment_method_id but do not include invoice_payment_method_id.
premises.reason: An extra column could violate an exact-schema interpretation of the data contract.
